Hi Sara / Tom / Aisha —

Thanks again for the interest in a deeper look at Redwood Inference. Rather than three separate 1:1s, would you be open to a short cohort session (45 mins) where we walk through:

- a quick latency/cost demo for a real prompt mix,
- batching + caching walkthrough, and
- an optional breakouts Q&A (~10 mins).

We think this format will save time and help you compare notes on how inference economics maps to your workloads. Proposed slots (PDT):

1) Wed Jul 28 — 10:00am
2) Thu Jul 29 — 2:00pm
3) Fri Jul 30 — 4:00pm

Please reply with 1/2/3 (or \"none — suggest times\") and whether you prefer 45 or 60 minutes. Attached a quick slot poll and a matrix showing timezone overlap. Also let us know who will join from your side.

If this works, Ben will send the calendar invite + agenda.

Best,
